title: O Jesus, I Have Promised
description: O Jesus, I Have Promised in Tonic Solfa to ANGEL'S STORY: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses, and a piano.
about: John Ernest Bode wrote the words, first published in 1868. The tune, ANGEL'S STORY, is by Arthur Henry Mann (1881).
underlay: O Je-sus, I have prom-ised To serve Thee to the end; Be Thou for-ev-er near me, My Mas-ter and my Friend; I shall not fear the bat-tle If Thou art by my side, Nor wan-der from the path-way If Thou wilt be my Guide.

lines: To serve Thee to the end;
I shall not fear the battle
If Thou art by my side,
If Thou wilt be my Guide.
O let me feel Thee near me,
I see the sights that dazzle,
My foes are ever near me,
And shield my soul from sin.
O let me hear Thee speaking
O speak, and make me listen,
That where Thou art in glory
To serve Thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow,
